svg.aria-label: A terminal listing the th3-skills a coding agent uses, grouped by stage: Plan, Design, Build, Test, Ship. poc-spec-driven-builder: Research, spec and a test matrix before any code. design-core: Layout, copy and accessibility review with scores. design-flow: Figma screens with their flowchart drawn beside them. prompt-cache-kit: Keep agent prompts cache-friendly to cut token cost. thai-mock-naming: Safe Thai mock names for seeds and fixtures. qa: Q&A review, test evidence and ticket reports. dependency-vuln-explainer: How a CVE works and whether it reaches your app. devops: Infra changes in a fixed order, closed with a report. doc-style-builder: One Markdown source to matching PDF and DOCX. pdf-operations: Merge, split, reorder and stamp PDFs. podman-disk-reclaim: Shrink a Podman machine that ate the disk.
svg.title: th3-skills
